A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same CL-Splats research work, including complete supplementary Sections 7–12. Text, tables, figures, algorithms, and visually checked equations support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: V1 reports original reconstruction experiments, quantitative baseline comparisons, ablations, runtime measurements, and scene-history demonstrations in the main text and supplement.

after.justification: V2 retains these original empirical results and additionally reports camera-pose estimation and point-sampling comparisons in the supplement.

M1.justification: The proposed change detection, majority voting, adaptive point sampling, sphere pruning, local optimization kernel, and history recovery procedures remain unchanged. The additional experiments evaluate alternatives without revising the proposed algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same CL-Splats synthetic levels, five real-world scenes, CL-NeRF scenes, and object-change and multiday tasks. The added comparisons do not establish additional dataset or task coverage.

E2.justification: Supplementary Section 9.2 newly reports comparisons with two naive sampling alternatives: fixed-count sampling throughout the scene and within a fixed radius of inliers. Comparator membership in the existing benchmark tables remains unchanged.

E3.justification: V1 describes joint camera-pose estimation for its real-world experiments and outlines incremental registration as an option. V2 additionally reports testing incremental versus joint estimation on real-world scenes. Existing benchmark splits, metrics, resolutions, and training settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: V2 adds brief supplementary analyses of the accuracy–speed tradeoff for incremental pose estimation and reconstruction sensitivity to two simpler sampling strategies. The existing mask, optimization, convergence, and history-recovery analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seed counts, repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The newly reported average PSNR difference does not introduce a new uncertainty-reporting practice.

E6.justification: All tabulated results are retained. V2 newly reports an average 1.2 dB PSNR reduction with up to 20-fold speedup for incremental pose estimation, up to 6 dB lower PSNR with naive samplers, and successful segmentation of replacements with similar semantics. These are additional findings, not improvements to the existing benchmark scores.

T1.justification: Equations 1–9, the mathematical conditions, and the reasoning underlying update merging and history recovery are unchanged. Visual inspection confirms that apparent equation differences in extracted text are not mathematical revisions.

C1.justification: The introduction replaces the contribution bullet claiming a change-detection module and the first dynamic local optimization with a custom kernel with a narrower emphasis on spatially constrained local Gaussian optimization. The abstract and conclusion retain the central efficiency, reconstruction-quality, and application claims.

C2.justification: V2 qualifies the large-scene discussion by noting difficulty scaling the underlying representation to detailed driving data. Supplementary Section 9.2 also attributes the existing mask-underestimation failure to extremely thin structures, making the failure boundary more specific.

D1.justification: The implementation parameters, hardware information, data-preparation instructions, and incremental COLMAP recipe are retained. The abstract’s code and dataset release statement is unchanged. The new experimental summaries supply no additional numerical sampling parameters or detailed reproduction instructions.

R1.justification: The cited-work set and related-work comparisons remain unchanged. Updates to MVSplat, ActiveSplat, and DepthSplat references concern publication venues and dates rather than new works or substantive repositioning.

P1.justification: Changes are localized to a contribution bullet, short experimental and explanatory additions, and an acknowledgement update. The section hierarchy and most prose remain unchanged, without extensive rewriting or reorganization.

P2.justification: The same figures and tables are retained, with unchanged captions and table structures. Some embedded images have higher resolution, including Figure 4 and the Table 4 mask illustrations; spacing and text placement shift, and printed page numbers are removed.

improvement.justification: V2 modestly strengthens practical validation by testing the previously outlined incremental pose workflow and reporting sampling comparisons. It also clarifies thin-structure failures and qualifies scalability. These additions improve support and interpretation while preserving the existing evidence, but their brief reporting lacks detailed settings and per-scene results, limiting the overall gain.
